name: mouse
author: LizardMan
description: The driver for a USB mouse plugged into the OP-1 with a mini USB OTG adapter. An arrow on the screen takes the colour of the encoder it stands on: the wheel or a drag up and down turns that encoder, a click is its push. In Opus's menu it picks the rows. On the tape a click moves the playhead and a drag scrubs, the loop's marks and the clips are dragged where they are drawn (above, a clip on its way to another place and track), and the wheel zooms.
